# Josh & Jordan's Kitchen

> No-talking home cooking and scratch baking from Josh & Jordan's Kitchen. Josh cooks savory meals by feel with no measuring cups; Jordan runs the oven. Tight method cuts, minimally cut full-process sessions, kitchen tools, and recipes.

Josh & Jordan's Kitchen is published by Built by Josh Studio LLC (https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt). Contact: support@builtbyjoshstudio.com. Fuller file for this site: https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms-full.txt.

## Main pages

- [Josh & Jordan's Kitchen — Full-Process Cook Videos, Kitchen Tools & Recipes](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/): No-talking home cooking and scratch baking from Josh & Jordan's Kitchen. Josh cooks savory meals by feel with no measuring cups; Jordan runs the oven. Tight method cuts, minimally cut full-process sessions, kitchen tools, and recipes.
- [Blog · Josh & Jordan's Kitchen](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/): Cooking essays and kitchen-tool posts from Josh & Jordan's Kitchen.
- [Nước Mắm — A Vietnamese Family Cookbook by Josh Tran](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/cookbook/): 56 pages of simple, home-style Vietnamese cooking — summer rolls, bún bowls, bánh mì, and a twelve-hour phở. Balanced by tasting, not measuring. $3.99 ebook.
- [Free Kitchen Calculators & Cooking Tools · Josh & Jordan's Kitchen](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/): Free, ad-free kitchen calculators — recipe scaling, air fryer conversion, cost per serving, brining, dough hydration, roasting timelines, and more. No signup, runs in your browser.
- [Cooking Videos — Full-Process Cooks, Short Cuts & Kitchen Basics](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/videos/): No-talking home cooking and scratch baking videos two ways: a tight method cut, or a minimally cut full-process session at normal speed. Plus kitchen basics like board care.

## Kitchen tools

- [Air Fryer Conversion Calculator | Oven to Air Fryer, Free](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/air-fryer-conversion-calculator/): Convert any oven recipe to air fryer settings — temperature, time, and when to check, tuned by food type. Fahrenheit or Celsius. Free, ad-free, no signup.
- [Brine Calculator | Free Wet & Dry Brine Salt & Time Math](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/brine-calculator/): Calculate wet or dry brines for turkey, chicken, pork, and more. Get precise salt amounts, water ratios, sugar options, and brining time recommendations.
- [Cookware & Pan Guide | Free Kitchen Utility](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/cookware-pan-guide/): Select the best cookware material and pan shape for any cooking task. Interactive advisor, material explorer, and care guidelines. Free, ad-free, local-first.
- [Cost Per Serving Calculator | Free Recipe Cost Calculator](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/cost-per-serving-calculator/): Free cost per serving calculator. Enter what you used, the pack size, and the pack price to get total recipe cost and price per serving. No signup, no ads.
- [Bread & Dough Hydration Calculator | Pizza & Pasta, Free](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/dough-hydration-calculator/): Bread hydration calculator for bread, pizza, and pasta dough. Enter your flour and get water, salt, and yeast by baker's percentage. Free, no ads, no signup.
- [Turkey & Meat Thawing Time Calculator | Fridge or Cold Water](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/meat-thawing-planner/): How long to thaw a turkey, chicken, roast, or steaks: enter the weight and get safe fridge and cold-water thawing times from USDA guidance. Free, no ads.
- [Baking Pan Conversion Calculator | Swap Cake Pan Sizes, Free](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/pan-swap-calculator/): Swap one baking pan for another: round, square, rectangular, muffin, or Bundt. Get the ingredient multiplier and a bake-time warning. Free and ad-free.
- [Perfect Roast Pull Temp Calculator | Carryover Cooking Math](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/perfect-roast-pull-temp-calculator/): Calculate the exact temperature to pull your roast, steak, or turkey from the oven to account for carryover cooking. A free, ad-free culinary utility.
- [Recipe Nutrition Calculator | Calories & Macros Per Serving](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/recipe-nutrition-calculator/): Paste a recipe's ingredients and get calories, protein, carbs, and fat per serving, plus an estimated Nutrition Facts label. Free, no ads, no signup.
- [Pork Roast Cooking Time Calculator | Reverse Timeline, Free](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/reverse-roasting-calculator/): Pork roast cooking time, worked backward from dinner — enter a pork loin, shoulder, ham, turkey, or beef roast and serve time for an exact oven timeline. Free.
- [Universal Recipe Scaler | Ad-Free Ingredient Converter](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/universal-recipe-scaler/): Instantly scale, multiply, or divide cooking and baking recipes. A free, local-first utility to convert portions and metric measurements with zero ads.
- [Yeast Converter | Active Dry, Instant, & Fresh Yeast Ratios](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/yeast-converter/): Convert yeast measurements between Active Dry, Instant, and Fresh yeast. Convert grams, ounces, teaspoons, and packets with automatic weight guards. Free, ad-free.

## Blog posts

- [The Baking Pan Swap Calculator — Free Pan Conversion Tool](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/baking-pan-swap-calculator/): Convert any recipe between pan sizes — square, round, rectangle, muffin tin, Bundt — with an instant scaling multiplier and bake-time warning. Free, no signup.
- [Building the Brine Calculator: Brining Math Worth Getting Right](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/brine-calculator/): Build notes on the brine calculator: why brining math matters, what it handles — salt type, protein weight, brine strength, time — and how it fits the kit.
- [Building the Universal Recipe Scaler — Local-First, Ad-Free](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/building-the-universal-recipe-scaler/): How I built a free, instant recipe scaler — vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, no backend, localStorage, JSON-LD — the regex problem, scale-lock logic, and a clean, fast interface with an interactive prep checklist.
- [Cook the Way You Want to Cook — Against Culinary Purism](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/cook-the-way-you-want-to-cook/): A daily home cook's argument for cooking the way you want to cook. The only rules worth following are food safety and a few real technique rules. Everything else is yours.
- [How to Calculate Cost Per Serving (Formula + Examples)](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/cost-per-serving-calculator/): The cost per serving formula with worked examples: package price to per-serving math, waste allowances, and the mistakes that throw the number off.
- [Dough Hydration Calculator — Baker's Percentages by Tynkr Tools & Co](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/dough-hydration-calculator/): Free baker's-percentage calculator for bread, pizza, pasta, and noodle dough — flour absorbency warnings, egg conversion for fresh pasta, kansui math for ramen.
- [How I Actually Cook Rice — The Finger Method, No Measuring Cup](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/how-i-cook-rice-finger-method/): The Vietnamese finger method for rice-cooker water, from someone who has cooked rice a few thousand times. Jasmine rice, rice cooker, no measuring cup required.
- [How I Learned to Cook — From Watching My Dad to Tuesday Gỏi Cuốn](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/how-i-learned-to-cook/): Watching my dad cook most nights, the first dish I made alone at twelve, and why I still cook gỏi cuốn on weeknights — on learning to cook by absorbing it.
- [How I Make Phở at Home — The Two-Day Method (and Spinach)](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/how-i-make-pho-two-day-method/): A home cook's two-day, stock-first phở bò — every step explained, honest non-traditional choices included (spinach in the bowl), plus a one-day shortcut.
- [Most of Cooking Happens at the Cutting Board (My Knife & Board Habits)](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/knife-and-cutting-board-habits/): The Dalstrong Barbarian knives and end-grain Lionswood teak board I bought years before starting the channel, plus the three prep habits that keep them sharp.
- [Meat Thawing Planner — Real Thermodynamics, Free Tool](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/meat-thawing-planner/): A free calculator for safe meat thawing using real protein-specific thermal math. Refrigerator and cold-water methods, USDA-compliant, with built-in food safety guardrails.
- [Perfect Roast Pull Temp Calculator — Free Carryover Cooking Tool](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/perfect-roast-pull-temp-calculator/): Free carryover cooking calculator: the exact pull-from-heat temp for brisket, duck breast, venison, fish, and steak — resting handled. No signup, no ads.
- [Reverse Roasting Timeline Calculator — Free Tool by Tynkr Tools & Co](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/reverse-roasting-timeline-calculator/): Free calculator that tells you exactly when to start cooking based on your target dinner time — turkey, prime rib, pork shoulder, salmon, and more. No signup, no ads.
- [What I Actually Keep in My Kitchen — A Seven-Ingredient Cooking System](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/what-i-actually-keep-in-my-kitchen/): The pantry list and broth-based weekly system that lets me cook from scratch every night. Plus the honest tired-night meals: fried bologna and scrambled eggs.
- [Why More Home Cooks Should Batch Broths — A Real Cost & Time Breakdown](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/why-home-cooks-should-batch-broths/): Why batching broth weekly pays off for a home cook: real cost and time numbers, plus the techniques that make it work — fat removal, double-strain, demi-glace.
- [Why I Skip Non-Stick (Even Ceramic) — And What’s Actually on My Stove](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/why-i-skip-nonstick-cookware/): Why I skip Teflon and ceramic non-stick pans under high heat, and why bare clad stainless steel and an enameled Dutch oven handle everything on my stove.
- [How to Convert Between Active Dry, Instant, and Fresh Yeast](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/yeast-converter/): How to swap one yeast for another — the ratios, why active dry, instant, and fresh aren't interchangeable gram-for-gram, and how the swap affects your rise.
